title: Dubu Jorim (Spicy Braised Tofu)
summary: Golden pan-fried tofu slices simmered briefly in a chilli, soy and sesame glaze with spring onion.

ingredients.item: Korean chilli flakes or mild chilli flakes
spring onion, cut into thin strips
firm tofu, cut into 1.2 cm slices

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Whisk the water, syrup, honey, vinegar, soy sauce, fish sauce and sesame oil, then stir in the garlic, chilli flakes, fresh chilli, jalapeño, onion and half the spring onion.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Press the tofu slices between kitchen paper to remove surface water.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu 3-5 min each side until golden.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Pour in the sauce and simmer about 2 min, spooning it over the tofu until glossy and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with the remaining spring onion and serve with rice.

tips: Dry the tofu well so it browns.
Turn the slices gently with a fish slice.
Add more chilli flakes for extra heat.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
